title: Chapter 130: Welcome to Mu Yang High School
html:
Chen Ge placed Xiaoxiao on the table. The mischievous rag doll, normally eager to sneak away, was unusually obedient. He could sense her fear—an emotion she had not shown even before the mirror monster. Is the cat exceptionally powerful, or is Xiaoxiao simply too weak?

Curled on the chair, the white cat watched the four kittens in the basket, indifferent to everything else.

If I’m adopting her, she needs a name. I can’t call her “white cat” forever.

This was Chen Ge’s first pet. He sat on the floor and studied her. “We met at night in the rain. How about Night Rain?”

The cat did not move, but Chen Ge could sense its displeasure.

“Too pretentious? How about Fortune, for good luck?” The cat turned away as though she could not bear to look at him.

“Still no? You’re completely white, so… Snow? Milk? Rice?” Perhaps Chen Ge had moved too close and seemed threatening. The cat bared her teeth, whiskers trembling, and the wound on her face began bleeding again.

“You really are wild.” Other people owned cute, cuddly cats; his behaved like a tiger. Eyeing the wound on her face, Chen Ge cautiously backed away.

“You’re more tiger than cat. Maybe I should call you White Tiger.” Realizing how strange it was to name a cat after another animal, Chen Ge started to reconsider. Then she sprang upright, ears pricked, leaped from the chair, and clawed frantically at the break room door.

What is it?Desperate to escape, the cat raked the wood. Chen Ge quickly opened the door. She didn’t react this strongly to Mu Yang High School. She must have sensed something!

The cat raced straight to the first-floor bathroom and gouged a deep mark into its wooden door.

The first-floor bathroom?Chen Ge’s heart lurched. He checked the time: midnight.

The mirror!He rushed in and tore away the black cloth. The red door had appeared on schedule, but this time blood-colored liquid seeped around its edges. Every few seconds it shook, as though someone were pushing from the other side.

Chen Ge dared not act rashly. He looked at the real cubicle door and saw it tremble in perfect unison with the reflection. At midnight, this ordinary door seemed to become a bridge between two worlds.

Something is behind it!Chen Ge seized a mop and watched the lock jump. Thank goodness he had remembered to secure the door; otherwise, the creature might already be inside the Haunted House.

The shaking intensified. All Chen Ge could do was endure the minute. He had no wish to provoke the monster or learn its identity. He only wanted to run his Haunted House in peace.

The lock bucked violently and seemed ready to fail. Chen Ge tightened his grip on the mop, prepared to fight. Beside him, the white cat lowered her head, arched her back, and readied herself to pounce.

Nothing emerged. After one minute, the bloody door vanished from the mirror and the real one fell still.

It’s over.Both Chen Ge and the cat relaxed. Then she glared at him, as though saying, “I’ve been here less than an hour, and you’ve already frightened me twice. Is this any place for a cat?”

“You dare glare at me?” When Chen Ge reached for her, she evaded his arms and raced back to the staff break room.

She won’t even let me touch her. What a coldhearted cat.Alone in the bathroom, Chen Ge unlocked the cubicle and examined the door. Something had battered it from the other side, loosening the lock.

I need a sturdier door.He considered destroying it outright, but feared that even if he demolished the entire cubicle, the door in the mirror would remain.

The first time the door appeared, nothing happened. The second time, I heard something like a body being dragged behind it. Tonight, someone tried to break through.Chen Ge covered the mirror again and stared at the black cloth. My parents said the door at the Third Sick Hall had opened again. Is it like this one? Has the hospital become a nest for these monsters?

No one could answer him. He could rely only on himself. Chen Ge fetched boards from the prop room and reinforced the door. By the time he finished, it was 1:00 a.m.

I need some sleep. I have to collect the mannequins early tomorrow.He placed a quilt beside the white cat and climbed into bed.

His alarm woke him at 7:00 a.m. The cat stirred at the same instant, tensing at the slightest sound.

“Time to work.” Chen Ge called Uncle Xu and borrowed the park’s truck to collect the mannequin bodies. The cat guarded the basket so fiercely that he could not approach the kittens; their burial would have to wait.

Two trips later, all the bodies stood inside the Haunted House. Headless figures filled the corridor. Uncle Xu took one look and fled behind a flimsy excuse.

Are they really that frightening?Chen Ge removed the wooden boards, matched each head to its body, screwed them together, and carried the mannequins into Mu Yang High School.

Inside the sealed classroom, he dressed the mannequins one by one. As he finished the last, the black phone vibrated.

“Mu Yang High School Hidden Mission completed: bodies constructed for the twenty-four spirits in the sealed classroom!

“Mission reward obtained: The Returners’ Goodwill. You may now issue them simple instructions through the phone!

“Warning! Once the lingering spirit leaves the scenario, they will go berserk! Please be careful!”

With every Hidden Mission complete, the Two-Star Scenario could officially open.

Should I invite He San for a free trial? He claims not to enjoy it, but I think he has fun every time.
